lines.zh: 缓慢挪动，腐烂肢体吱吱作响。
lines.en: SLOWLY SCRAPE, FLESH MAKES SQUEAKING NOISES.

lines.zh: 我左腿拖着，鞋早就没了。
lines.en: My left leg drags and my shoes are long gone.

lines.zh: 腐烂的血液在地面流淌。
缓慢爬行，腐肉摩擦地面。
腐烂的骨骼发出咯吱声。
腐烂的皮肤在风中摇曳。
腐烂的肌肉绷紧又松懈。

lines.en: My ankle faces backwards. I still walk.

lines.zh: 腐烂的牙齿咬合发出嘎吱声。
膝盖反着弯，一步一步挪过来。
lines.en: My knees bend the wrong way as I shuffle over.

lines.zh: 拖着一只断腿，在土里画线。
lines.en: I drag a broken leg, drawing a line in the dirt.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指摆弄着泥土。
注意到玩家，腐烂的视线凝视着。
我用断指点了点你的胸口。
lines.en: I tap your chest with a broken finger.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手臂试图抓向玩家。
腐烂的皮肤颤抖着靠近玩家。
腐烂的肌肉紧绷着想要攻击。
腐烂的手臂尝试围堵玩家。
腐烂的皮肤扭曲着靠近玩家。
腐烂的肌肉绷紧着接近玩家。
它歪着头，像在数你有几块肉。
lines.en: It tilts its head, as if counting your cuts of meat.
My leg is broken, I can't move!

lines.zh: 腐烂的骨头在吱吱作响！
它的断腿又折了一下，爬不起来。
lines.en: Its broken leg snaps again, and it can't get up.
Yum, the rotting flesh is so good!
The rotting flesh gives me strength!
The rotting flesh is my eternal feast!

lines.zh: 我和它互相啃着肩膀，算作亲近。
lines.en: We gnaw each other's shoulders; that counts as closeness.

lines.zh: 我从泥里抠出半块铁，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I dig a scrap of iron from the mud and hold it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的衣服烂成条，还挂着。
我捡起断刀，握不住也捡。
lines.en: I pick up a broken knife; my grip fails and I pick it up anyway.
Dragging each step, I still catch up.

lines.zh: 它咬住你的衣角，往下拽。
lines.en: It bites your hem and pulls you down.

lines.zh: 废墟那头的脚步，我听见了。
lines.en: Footsteps beyond the ruins; I hear them.

lines.zh: 废墟那头的脚步，我听见了
lines.en: I heard those steps beyond the rubble — 行尸, target acquire
That living smell behind the ruins.

lines.zh: 血腥味拐过街角，我转过去了。
lines.en: The smell of blood turns the corner and so do I.

lines.zh: 血味飘过来，它的头转得很慢。
lines.en: The smell of blood reaches it, and its head turns slowly.

lines.zh: 它听见你喘气，就不走了。
lines.en: It hears you pant, and stops wandering.

lines.zh: 你受伤了，它闻得比你早。
lines.en: You're bleeding, and it smelled it before you did.

lines.zh: 一瘸一拐，也要朝你过来。
lines.en: Limping or not, it comes for you.

lines.zh: 它的牙磨了一下，认准了方向。
lines.en: It grinds its teeth once and picks a direction.

lines.zh: 我的下颌已经合不上了，还想咬。
lines.en: My jaw no longer closes, and still I want to bite.

lines.zh: 末日之后，没有哪扇门挡得住我。
lines.en: After the end, no door stops me.

lines.zh: 我的裤腿拖在泥里，一步步靠近。
lines.en: My trouser leg drags in the mud as I close in.

lines.zh: 吃掉你，我的灵魂会更强！
lines.en: Eat you, my soul will be stronger!

lines.zh: 它张开嘴，咬合声很清脆。
lines.en: It opens its mouth, and the bite clicks sharply.
You can't outrun it. It never tires.

lines.zh: 一瘸一拐，但方向一直是你。
lines.en: It limps, but always toward you.

lines.zh: 它抬手，指甲缝里全是泥。
lines.en: It raises a hand, nails packed with mud.
You step back once, and it advances twice.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子当成入口。
lines.en: It treats your shadow as a doorway.

lines.zh: 别让它咬到，咬了就治不好。
lines.en: Don't let it bite. A bite never heals.

lines.zh: 它在等你的伤口流血变慢。
lines.en: It waits for your wound to stop bleeding so fast.
My hand has you, and it will not open.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的护腕，牙全崩了。
lines.en: I bite your bracer and my teeth all crack.
I wedged myself into the gap of your teeth.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿已经松了，还是能咬。
lines.en: My teeth are loose. They still bite.
Your flesh is mine! — 行尸, melee attack

lines.zh: 一口咬住，牙齿嵌进肉里。
lines.en: It bites down, teeth sunk into flesh.

lines.zh: 它撕开你的袖子，连皮带肉。
lines.en: It tears your sleeve off, skin included.

lines.zh: 这一口带了尸毒，别指望好。
lines.en: This bite carries the rot. Don't expect to heal.

lines.zh: 牙齿摩擦的声音就在耳边。
lines.en: The grinding of teeth is right at your ear.

lines.zh: 天亮以后，我躲进破屋里。
lines.en: At dawn I hide inside a broken house.

lines.zh: 废墟的瓦砾动了动，它站起来。
lines.en: Rubble in the ruins shifts, and it stands up.

lines.zh: 某具尸体忽然学会了走路。
lines.en: A corpse suddenly learns how to walk.

lines.zh: 尘土里，一只手先伸出来。
lines.en: From the dust, a hand comes out first.

lines.zh: 末日之后，尸体自己会找路。
lines.en: After the end, corpses find their own way.

lines.zh: 它站在马路中间，慢慢转身。
lines.en: It stands in the middle of the road and turns slowly.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，骨头作响！
炸开的铁片扎满我半边身子！
闪电击中了我，疼痛难忍！
虚空的寒意侵蚀我的灵魂！
